title: Connectivity equals minimum degree when the minimum degree is large
statement: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph on $\nu$ vertices with minimum degree $\delta$ and vertex connectivity $\kappa(G)$. If $\delta \ge \nu - 2$, then $\kappa(G) = \delta$.
replaced:
A simple graph with \texttt{$\delta$ $\ge$ $\nu$ $-$ 2} has \texttt{$\kappa$ =
$\delta$}.

3.1.3 (a) Show that if $G$ is simple and $\delta \ge \nu-2$, then
$\kappa = \delta$.
  (b) Find a simple graph $G$ with $\delta = \nu-3$ and
$\kappa < \delta$.
